gloss: suddenly, in haste, on short notice

definitions.gloss: suddenly, in haste, on short notice, at the last minute
definitions.explanation: Doing something hastily or without advance planning, typically because of unexpected circumstances. Implies urgency and a change from the original plan.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}が{急遽|きゅうきょ}{中止|ちゅうし}になった。
{急遽|きゅうきょ}{代|か}わりのメンバーを{探|さが}すことになった。
examples.english: We had to find a replacement member on short notice.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{予定|よてい}を{急遽|きゅうきょ}{変更|へんこう}せざるを{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: Due to the typhoon, we had no choice but to change our plans at the last minute.

notes:
USAGE:
{急遽|きゅうきょ} implies that an action was taken hastily due to unforeseen circumstances. It differs from {突然|とつぜん} (suddenly), which simply describes something happening without warning. {急遽|きゅうきょ} emphasizes the reactive, last-minute nature of a decision or action.

Common in news reporting and business contexts. Slightly more formal than {急|きゅう}に.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}{決|き}まる: to be decided on short notice
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}{変更|へんこう}する: to change at the last minute
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}{帰国|きこく}する: to return home urgently
- {急遽|きゅうきょ}{開催|かいさい}する: to hold (an event) on short notice
